name: Fighter
description: Fighters are masters of weapons, armor, and battlefield tactics. Their discipline, durability, and specialized combat training let them adapt to nearly any fight.

options.label: Chain Mail, a Greatsword, a Flail, and 8 Javelins
Studded Leather Armor, a Scimitar, a Shortsword, a Longbow, 20 Arrows, and a Quiver

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: Focus on raw physical power to deal devastating hits.

grants.name: Improved Critical
grants.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

grants.name: Remarkable Athlete
grants.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

grants.name: Additional Fighting Style
grants.description: Learn a second Fighting Style option of your choice, different from the one you already know.

grants.name: Heroic Warrior
grants.description: During combat, whenever you start your turn without Heroic Inspiration, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration.

grants.name: Superior Critical
grants.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.

grants.name: Survivor
grants.description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and a roll of 18-20 grants the benefit of rolling a 20. At the start of each turn, regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: Use combat maneuvers powered by superiority dice to control the battlefield.

grants.name: Combat Superiority
grants.description: You have four d8 Superiority Dice, gaining a fifth at Fighter level 7 and a sixth at level 15. They become d10s at level 10 and d12s at level 18. A maneuver save DC equals 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier. You regain all expended dice after a Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Combat Maneuvers
grants.description: Learn three maneuvers, then two more at Fighter levels 7, 10, and 15. Whenever a level grants maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know. You can use only one maneuver per attack.

options.name: Ambush
options.description: Add your Superiority Die to a Stealth check or to an initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.description: Swap places with a willing creature within 5 ft.; add the die to your AC or theirs until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.description: Forgo one attack to direct an ally; it can use its reaction to attack, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.description: Add your Superiority Die to a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or drops an item of your choice.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; the next attack against the target by someone else has advantage before your next turn.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: As a Bonus Action, expend the die to Disengage and add the roll to your AC until your next turn starts.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.description: Bonus action to feint against a creature within 5 ft.; you have advantage on your next attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: As a Bonus Action, expend the die to Dash. After moving at least 5 feet straight toward a target, add the die to one melee hit made as part of this turn's Attack action.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; an ally can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Parry
options.description: Reaction: when damaged by a melee attack, reduce the damage by the die roll plus your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.description: After you miss with an attack roll, add the Superiority Die, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 ft. away.

options.name: Rally
options.description: Bonus action: an ally within 30 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll plus half your Fighter level, rounded down.

options.name: Riposte
options.description: Reaction: when a creature misses you with a melee attack, make a melee attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: Hit: choose another creature within 5 ft. of the original target; if the attack would hit it too, it takes damage equal to the die roll.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.description: Add your Superiority Die to an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone.

grants.name: Student of War: Artisan's Tools
grants.description: Gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools.

grants.name: Student of War: Fighter Skill
grants.description: Gain one additional proficiency from the Fighter's level 1 skill list.

grants.name: Know Your Enemy
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, learn whether a visible creature within 30 feet has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities and what they are. Use this once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a Superiority Die.

grants.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d10)
grants.description: Your Superiority Dice turn into d10s.

grants.name: Relentless
grants.description: Once per turn when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use that result instead of expending a Superiority Die.

grants.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
grants.description: Your Superiority Dice become d12s.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: Combine martial mastery with arcane spells from the wizard spell list.

grants.name: Spellcasting
grants.description: Prepare and cast Wizard spells using Intelligence. You know two Wizard cantrips, learning a third at Fighter level 10, and can replace one whenever you gain a Fighter level. You regain spell slots after a Long Rest, can replace one prepared level 1+ spell whenever you gain a Fighter level, and can use an Arcane Focus.

grants.name: War Bond
grants.description: Bond with a weapon during a 1-hour ritual that can be performed during a Short Rest. You can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon while conscious, and can summon it from the same plane as a Bonus Action. You can maintain up to two bonds.

grants.name: War Magic
grants.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a Wizard cantrip that has a casting time of an action.

grants.name: Eldritch Strike
grants.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on its next save against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

grants.name: Arcane Charge
grants.description: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the additional action.

grants.name: Improved War Magic
grants.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two attacks with one level 1 or level 2 Wizard spell that has a casting time of an action.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.description: Use psionic energy to augment your physical attacks and protect your allies.

grants.name: Psionic Power
grants.description: Your Psionic Energy Dice fuel Protective Field and Psionic Strike. You have four d6s at Fighter level 3, six d8s at level 5, eight d8s at level 9, eight d10s at level 11, ten d10s at level 13, and twelve d12s at level 17. A Short Rest restores one die and a Long Rest restores all. Protective Field is a Reaction that reduces damage to a visible creature within 30 feet by the die plus Intelligence (minimum 1). Once per turn after a weapon hit within 30 feet, Psionic Strike deals Force damage equal to the die plus Intelligence.

grants.name: Telekinetic Movement
grants.description: As a Magic action, move one visible willing creature other than yourself or one loose Large-or-smaller object within 30 feet up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space. A Tiny object can instead move to or from your hand. Use this once per Short or Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a Psionic Energy Die.

grants.name: Psi-Powered Leap
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the turn. Use this once per Short or Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a Psionic Energy Die.

grants.name: Telekinetic Thrust
grants.description: When Psionic Strike damages a target, it makes a Strength save against DC 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus. On a failure, give it the Prone condition or move it up to 10 feet horizontally.

grants.name: Guarded Mind
grants.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage. If you start your turn Charmed or Frightened, expend a Psionic Energy Die without an action to end every effect on yourself causing those conditions.

grants.name: Bulwark of Force
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, grant Half Cover for 1 minute to creatures within 30 feet, including yourself, up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one). The effect ends if you are Incapacitated. Use this once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a Psionic Energy Die.

grants.name: Telekinetic Master
grants.description: Telekinesis is always prepared. Cast it once without a spell slot or components using Intelligence, and while concentrating on it you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action on each turn. Restore the free casting after a Long Rest or by expending a Psionic Energy Die.

grants.name: Skill Proficiencies
grants.description: Choose 2 skills from the fighter list.

grants.name: Fighting Style
grants.description: Gain one Fighting Style feat. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace it with another Fighting Style feat.

grants.name: Second Wind
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. A Short Rest restores one use and a Long Rest restores all uses.

grants.name: Weapon Mastery
grants.description: Choose 3 weapons you have proficiency with. You gain that weapon's mastery property whenever you attack with it. Swap choices after a long rest.

grants.name: Action Surge (1/rest)
grants.description: Take one additional action on your turn, except the Magic action, once per Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Tactical Mind
grants.description: When you fail an ability check, expend a Second Wind use without an action to roll 1d10 and add it to the check. If the check still fails, the Second Wind use is not expended.

grants.name: Fighter Subclass
grants.description: Choose a Fighter subclass, gaining its features at this level and again at Fighter levels 7, 10, 15, and 18.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Weapon Mastery (4th weapon)
grants.description: Choose 1 additional weapon you have proficiency with to gain its mastery property.

grants.name: Extra Attack
grants.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.name: Tactical Shift
grants.description: Whenever you use Second Wind, you can move up to half your Speed as part of that bonus action without provoking opportunity attacks.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Fighter Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Indomitable
grants.description: When you fail a saving throw, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level and use the new roll. You gain a second use at Fighter level 13 and a third at level 17, restoring all uses after a Long Rest.

grants.name: Tactical Master
grants.description: You can replace the mastery property of the weapon you attack with for Push, Sap, or Slow instead, for that attack.

grants.name: Fighter Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Weapon Mastery (5th weapon)
grants.description: Choose 1 additional weapon you have proficiency with to gain its mastery property.

grants.name: Two Extra Attacks
grants.description: Attack three times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Indomitable Improvement
grants.description: You can now use Indomitable twice before a Long Rest.

grants.name: Studied Attacks
grants.description: If you miss with an attack roll against a creature, you have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Fighter Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Weapon Mastery (6th weapon)
grants.description: Choose 1 additional weapon you have proficiency with to gain its mastery property.

grants.name: Action Surge (2/rest)
grants.description: Use Action Surge twice per short or long rest, but only once per turn.

grants.name: Indomitable Improvement
grants.description: You can now use Indomitable three times before a Long Rest.

grants.name: Fighter Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Epic Boon
grants.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify. Boon of Combat Prowess is recommended.

grants.name: Three Extra Attacks
grants.description: Attack four times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
